title: Rich Edit
blurb: Live-styled Markdown editor with search, links and tables
note: Order matters: McBoundedCache is used by McMarkdownInline, McMarkdownTable, McSqlite and McCodeEvaluator; McCodeEval needs McMarkdownCode's node to key its cache; McMarkdownTable's cell reader and McSqlite depend on McRelation; McMarkdown's visitor calls into McMarkdownInline, McMarkdownTable, McSqlite and McCodeEvaluator; McRichEdit's styler calls into McMarkdown.
